name: tiller2qif-map-syntax
description: Syntax highlighting and chart-of-accounts completion for Finance::Tiller2QIF category-mapping files

tiller2qifMap.coaPath.description: Path to a chart-of-accounts export. When set, the destination column of map rules offers completions from this file. Supports a leading ~ for your home directory.

enumDescriptions: Detect the format automatically from the file
tiller2qifMap.coaFormat.description: Format of the tiller2qifMap.coaPath export. "auto" detects it from the file; set this explicitly if detection picks the wrong loader. Only GnuCash CSV is built in today — see loaders/index.js in the extension source to contribute support for another program's export.
